statement: NVIDIA H200 shipments to China remain 'trivial' despite ~$10B in approved export licenses to roughly ten Chinese firms, with a 25% tariff on China-routed chips.
why: Approved licenses are not translating into shipments, so China-tied H200 revenue is largely unrealized, a demand-realization drag.

impact.mechanism: Export-control friction and tariffs suppress realized H200 sales into China despite large approved license value.

evidence.excerpt: very few shipments against licenses for H200s and equivalents have taken place

confidence.basis: Secondary reporting of US Commerce testimony; single document.
